title.en: Generate cases from an open pull request diff
title.uk: Згенерувати кейси з diff відкритого pull request
title.fr: Generate cases from an open pull request diff
title.es: Generate cases from an open pull request diff
title.de: Generate cases from an open pull request diff

description.en: On Generate, pick a linked GitHub/GitLab/Forgejo/Gitea repo, select an open PR/MR, preview changed files with token budget, exclude noise, and generate draft cases that record PR/branch/commit provenance.
description.uk: На сторінці Generate оберіть пов’язаний репозиторій, відкритий PR/MR, перегляньте змінені файли в межах бюджету токенів і згенеруйте чернетки з джерелом PR/гілка/коміт.
description.fr: On Generate, pick a linked GitHub/GitLab/Forgejo/Gitea repo, select an open PR/MR, preview changed files with token budget, exclude noise, and generate draft cases that record PR/branch/commit provenance.
description.es: On Generate, pick a linked GitHub/GitLab/Forgejo/Gitea repo, select an open PR/MR, preview changed files with token budget, exclude noise, and generate draft cases that record PR/branch/commit provenance.
description.de: On Generate, pick a linked GitHub/GitLab/Forgejo/Gitea repo, select an open PR/MR, preview changed files with token budget, exclude noise, and generate draft cases that record PR/branch/commit provenance.

precondition.en: Signed in with llm_assist; project has a linked hosted automation repo with a token.
precondition.uk: Увійшли з llm_assist; у проєкті є пов’язаний hosted automation-репозиторій з токеном.
precondition.fr: Signed in with llm_assist; project has a linked hosted automation repo with a token.
precondition.es: Signed in with llm_assist; project has a linked hosted automation repo with a token.
precondition.de: Signed in with llm_assist; project has a linked hosted automation repo with a token.

action.en: Open Generate and the Cases from a PR or branch diff section
action.uk: Відкрити Generate і розділ кейсів з diff PR або гілки

expected_result.en: Repo and pull/branch controls are visible
expected_result.uk: Елементи керування репозиторієм і PR/гілкою видимі

action.en: Preview changed files and exclude at least one path
action.uk: Переглянути змінені файли й виключити хоча б один шлях

expected_result.en: Token budget updates and the excluded file is unchecked
expected_result.uk: Бюджет токенів оновлюється, виключений файл знято з вибору

action.en: Generate and save drafts from the diff
action.uk: Згенерувати й зберегти чернетки з diff

expected_result.en: Drafts persist and case detail shows generation provenance
expected_result.uk: Чернетки збережено, у деталях кейсу видно джерело генерації
